title: 第9章 擂台对决第10章 异能兽
content_zh:
下午如期而至，微风和煦，万里晴空。
炎门的弟子们开始了第三科目测试：拳脚功夫。
华丽的衣服，赤红的纹路，飘飘然如仙界子弟般，他们意气风发，他们畅所欲言，他们心怀志向，他们心向远方，一切都向最美好的未来发展。
“遇到了拳脚功夫，这我可最擅长”
焱傅韩自信地说道，“别说大话，到时候擂台上，把你打的满地找牙”
焱梦葳反驳道，“哎呦嚯，你还挺自信”
“比你自信一点”
“好的，前两项都是你赢了，这一项我绝对要认真”
“随便你怎么认真，我不怕你”
两个人互怼着，一直怼到训练场。
焱言潇洒地走着，身后依旧跟着小师妹益萌。
焱小昂自从上次就差一秒，只要再坚持一秒，就赢了，可惜还是差那么一点点，看来他们的天赋，我一定可以靠努力超越！
李典一个人走在路上，身后跟着许多羡慕他实力和美貌的弟子，她高冷的外表，寥寥的几句话，都能勾起他们心中的涟漪，他们期待着，可以和她做好朋友，好情侣也行。
擂台由木头搭建，呈正方形，木头和木头之间，系上粗大的绳子，擂台中心写着一个大大的“武”
字，字迹飘逸灵动，武字的精髓也的确如此。
这个擂台，所用的所有搭建的东西，都是注入过异能的，所以不会轻易的损坏，专用异能师的对练。
教老们早早的就来到了那里，他们巍然的站在那里，如一座高山般，令人难以逾越。
“拳脚功夫，现在开始！”
随着教老们的一声令下，异能珠自动匹配对手，两个相对的名字一组，一共有五个擂台，挑战成功者，可以继续匹配，败者则不能再继续，每打败一个人，记一分。
“原来是随机匹配，真麻烦，都不能揍你”

焱傅韩调侃道，“切，等我达到四五十个人，总会匹配到你的”
焱梦葳吹牛道，“哼！
你是真的拽，不过，恐怕没几个人，你就被打倒，到是只我一个人站在场上，战至终章！”
“多说无益，场上得分见事实！”
“行，我一定比你高”
两个人又相互拌嘴，喋喋不休。
“焱傅韩！”
去了，第一个叫到我，焱傅韩，活动着筋骨，扭动着脖子，拍了拍焱梦葳的肩膀，“看小爷我如何轻松拿捏他们！”
焱梦葳只是微笑着摇了摇头，对他说了三个字“加油啊”
焱傅韩翻过绳子的围栏，帅气落地，让我看看第一个对手是谁？“焱子昂对焱傅韩！”
台下有些人尖叫起来，大多数是喜欢他们的同门师妹，也有些人很看好这一场比赛，双方都是强有力的异能师，年轻一辈中的翘楚，至于谁胜谁败，都还不一定，看他们的表现了。
好啊，很好啊，早就看你很不爽了焱傅韩，之前高我一分，看到你们那些人幸灾乐祸的样子，我的内心无比的愤怒，现在终于有机会发泄，我一定狠狠的教育你！
“你好啊，小昂昂”
焱傅韩调皮道，“开始吧，多讲无益！”
焱小昂有些生气，异能覆盖在全身，蓝色异能在身体上迅速流动，“别那么急吗，你我是本门师弟，都拜在同一个师祖名下，几日不见，太想我了？”
content_en:
The afternoon arrived as expected, with a gentle breeze and clear skies.
The disciples of Yanmen began the third subject test: boxing and kicking kung fu.
Gorgeous clothes, red lines, fluttering like children of the fairy world, they are high-spirited, they speak freely, they have ambitions, their hearts are far away, everything is developing towards the best future.
"When it comes to boxing and kicking, I'm the best at it."
Yan Fuhan said confidently, "Don't talk nonsense. When the time comes in the ring, I will beat you to pieces."
Yan Mengwei retorted, "Oh, you are quite confident."
"More confident than you"
"Okay, you won the first two items, I will definitely take this one seriously."
"No matter how serious you are, I'm not afraid of you."
The two of them bickered with each other all the way to the training ground.
Yan Yan walked casually, with his junior sister Yimeng still following behind him.
Yan Xiaoang has been one second behind since last time. As long as he persists for one more second, he will win. Unfortunately, he is still just a little behind. It seems that with their talents, I can definitely surpass them through hard work!
Li Dian was walking alone on the road, followed by many disciples who admired his strength and beauty. Her cold appearance and few words could evoke ripples in their hearts. They looked forward to becoming good friends with her, or a good couple.
The ring is made of wood and is in a square shape. Thick ropes are tied between the wood and the wood. There is a big "武" written in the center of the ring.
The handwriting is elegant and lively, and the essence of the word "武" is indeed the same.
All the things used in this arena are infused with superpowers, so they won't be damaged easily. They are dedicated to the sparring of superpower masters.
The elders arrived there early, and they stood there majestically, like a high mountain, which was insurmountable.
"Fisting and kicking, start now!"
Following the command of the elders, the superpower beads automatically match the opponent. Two opposing names are paired together. There are five arenas in total. The winner of the challenge can continue to match, while the loser cannot continue. Each person defeated will be scored one point.
"It turns out it's a random match. It's so troublesome. I can't even beat you."
Yan Fuhan joked, "Tsk, when I reach forty or fifty people, I will definitely match you."
Yan Mengwei boasted, “Hmph!
You are really pulling me, but I am afraid that there are only a few people before you are knocked down, and I am the only one standing on the field, fighting to the end! "
"It's useless to say more, the facts are reflected on the field!"
"Okay, I must be taller than you"
The two people quarreled with each other again and chatted endlessly.
"Yan Fuhan!"
After we went, the first one who called me, Yan Fuhan, flexed his muscles and neck, patted Yan Mengwei on the shoulder, "Look how I can handle them easily!"
Yan Mengwei just smiled and shook her head and said three words to him, "Come on."
Yan Fuhan climbed over the rope fence and landed handsomely. Let me see who is the first opponent? "Yan Zi'ang versus Yan Fu Han!"
Some people in the audience screamed, most of them were fellow juniors who liked them, and some were very optimistic about this match. Both sides were powerful psychics, leaders among the younger generation. As for who would win and who would lose, it was not certain, it would all depend on their performance.
Okay, great, I've seen you very unhappy for a long time, Yan Fuhan. You were one point ahead of me before, and when I saw you people gloating about your misfortune, I felt extremely angry. Now I finally have a chance to vent, I will definitely teach you a lesson!
"Hello, little Angang"
Yan Fuhan said mischievously, "Let's get started. It's useless to talk too much!"
Yan Xiaoang was a little angry. His whole body was covered with superpowers, and blue superpowers were flowing rapidly on his body. "Don't be so impatient. You and I are junior brothers of our sect, and we both worship under the same master. We haven't seen each other for a few days. Do you miss me too much?"
